settings.heading: Size & Silhouette Guide
settings.subheading: All measurements reflect body measurements in inches and centimeters. All 18 Stitches garments feature 2-3 inches of extra inner margin for effortless personal tailoring.

settings.question: Can you customize the length or sleeves of a Kurta?
settings.answer: Yes, absolutely! We provide complimentary custom length adjustments and sleeve additions. Please reach out to our WhatsApp concierge after placing your order with your order number.

settings.question: How do I choose between two sizes?
settings.answer: For Indian ethnic wear like Kurta sets, we recommend selecting the size that matches your bust measurement. If you prefer a relaxed, airy drape or are in between sizes, we recommend sizing up.

settings.heading: Tailoring & Fit Inquiries
settings.subheading: Still unsure about your sizing? Our master pattern makers are ready to assist you.
